findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "human-design" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_rag_search · Private data: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools · Public sink: astroway_mcp_ai_chat, astroway_mcp_ai_comparison_coach, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_aspect, astroway_mcp_ai_explain_transit, astroway_hd_circuitry, astroway_hd_design_date, astroway_hd_dream_rave, astroway_hd_group_overlay, astroway_hd_hologenetic, astroway_hd_incarnation_cross, astroway_hd_penta, astroway_hd_rave_new_years, astroway_hd_sensitivity, astroway_hd_human_design, astroway_hd_human_design_compatibility, astroway_hd_human_design_transits, astroway_mcp_agent_debate, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate, astroway_mcp_multi_chart_context, astroway_mcp_rag_search, astroway_mcp_streaming, astroway_mcp_tool_call_stream · Destructive: astroway_account_status, astroway_agent_tools, astroway_mcp_multi_agent_coordinate.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
